purpose: Third reload of the same image, after the dock lost power again (the P4 log shows the FPGA stop answering at 18:16:57 local, one second before the P4 itself went away)
motor_supply_off_reported_by_operator: Operator: 'The esp32 is off and so is the power supply' just before the load. The P4's USB port was absent, so the P4 was unplugged.
fpga_image: bridge_safety (supervised bridge, SAFETY_ENABLE=1, RELEASE_TX=1) with host UART moved to G7 (host_rx) / G8 (host_tx)

rtl_sources.repo: ~/projects/sipeed-tang-primer-25k at 3733582 with uncommitted changes to servo/src/bridge.v; hashes below identify the files used

hashes_rechecked_before_load: Bitstream, constraints and all five RTL sources match the previous receipts.
tests_before_load: Unchanged image and sources since the previous receipt, whose make -C test and make -C cosim both passed
programming: SRAM only; openFPGALoader -b tangprimer25k, DONE (22:31:39Z to 22:31:42Z)
readback: Pending: through the P4's USB status line once the P4 is plugged back in

host.firmware: firmware/robot-link/esp32/build/robot_link.bin, rebuilt 2026-10-08 with a 2 s link summary on the USB console (CONFIG_RL_STATUS_LOG_MS=2000)
host.config: UART1 115200 baud, TX GPIO20 -> G7, RX GPIO21 <- G8, servos 0x1C0 (IDs 10-12), duty cap 100, AP robot-link on channel 6

event_before_load: Between the 21:47 load and the dock losing power, the P4 log showed the FPGA answering all along. A STOP from the page at 17:53:06 local changed the latch from reason 9 to reason 10, and reason 10 held, so S2 is not stuck. Non-frame bytes arrived from the FPGA during meter probing of the servo bus: 3 bytes by 18:15:21, then 890 more around 18:16:05.
open_issue: Servo bus: IDs 10-12 never answered (about 6 timeouts/s). Operator measured about 4 V on a lead contact with the supply off. Which contact (SIG or V+) is not yet confirmed. The FPGA's 3.3 V bank cannot drive 4 V.
note: SRAM image: a dock power cycle reverts to its flash image. Reload this image (with a new receipt) before powering the P4.
